sources.title: New Credit Facility Enhances Financial Flexibility

event.title: OpenAI revolving credit facility (October 2024)
event.summary: OpenAI set up a $4 billion revolving credit facility with a group of banks. The facility was undrawn when it closed.

amounts.label: Revolving credit facility (undrawn at closing)
amounts.quote: In addition to securing $6.6 billion in new funding from leading investors, we have established a new $4 billion credit facility with JPMorgan Chase, Citi, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Santander, Wells Fargo, SMBC, UBS, and HSBC.

facts.label: Lenders
facts.text: JPMorgan Chase, Citi, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Santander, Wells Fargo, SMBC, UBS and HSBC.
facts.quote: In addition to securing $6.6 billion in new funding from leading investors, we have established a new $4 billion credit facility with JPMorgan Chase, Citi, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Santander, Wells Fargo, SMBC, UBS, and HSBC.

facts.label: Undrawn
facts.text: The facility is revolving and was undrawn at closing.
facts.quote: This is a revolving credit facility that is undrawn at closing.

facts.label: Liquidity
facts.text: OpenAI said it then had access to over $10 billion in liquidity.
facts.quote: This means we now have access to over $10 billion in liquidity, which gives us the flexibility to invest in new initiatives and operate with full agility as we scale.

relations.note: Announced one day after the October 2024 funding round.
In March 2026 OpenAI said it expanded its existing revolving credit facility to about $4.7 billion. This amount is counted there.
